items.title: Biomea posts phase 1 data to pitch oral GLP-1 to potential partners, but investors appear unconvinced
items.summary: Biomea Fusion has shared phase 1 data on its oral GLP-1 prospect, shedding light on a small molecule designed to balance efficacy and gastrointestinal tolerability. Management hailed the data as a launchpad for talks with potential partners, but investors drove down the share price of the cash-strapped biotech.

items.title: Vir CEO sees ‘opportunity to do more deals’ after striking $1.9B Gilead pact for dual-masked TCEs
items.summary: Looking to expand its oncology portfolio, Gilead has tapped Vir Biotechnology’s masked T-cell engager tech in a potential $1.9 billion biobucks deal.

items.title: GSK to lay off over 1,200 roles in Belgium as cost-saving program picks up steam
items.summary: Up to 1,217 GSK employees in Belgium are at risk of losing their jobs as the Big Pharma rolls out its global cost-saving plans.

items.title: Zealand inks $1.2B Generate pact to add multispecific proteins to obesity pipeline
items.summary: Zealand Pharma is paying Generate Biomedicines $30 million upfront to collaborate on multispecific drug candidates for metabolic diseases. Milestones could bring the total value of the deal above $1 billion.

items.title: Agilent spends $240M upfront to buy digital pathology specialist Proscia
items.summary: Agilent Technologies is buying up the digital pathology software company Proscia in an all-cash transaction valued at $240 million with an additional $30 million on the cards for future performance milestones.

items.title: Stryker pens deal with CMR Surgical to advance robotic-assisted surgery
items.summary: Stryker will funnel around $400 million (£300 million) in a “strategic” investment in CMR Surgical and its robot surgery tech.

items.title: WCG unveils AI-powered solution to accelerate clinical trial kickoffs
items.summary: WCG, a clinical trials solutions provider, is launching an AI-powered program dubbed Activation Intelligence to help study sites accelerate clinical trial start-up.

items.title: Insulet’s Omnipod Discover platform sees full market release in US
items.summary: Insulet Corporation has announced the U.S. full market release of Omnipod Discover, a web-based data platform designed for Omnipod 5.

items.title: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer vaccine fails phase 3 test, significantly denting analysts’ confidence
items.summary: A phase 2/3 clinical trial of BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 has missed one of its dual primary endpoints. But with immature overall survival data offering a path to redemption, the German biotech is continuing to track patients in the metastatic head and neck cancer study.

items.title: Biotech builder Paragon imports Apogee's top brass after AbbVie buyout
items.summary: It’s been a busy morning for Paragon Labs. In addition to bringing over much of the leadership team from AbbVie-acquired Apogee Therapeutics, Paragon has overseen a reverse merger to take its hypertension-focused spinout Velaris Therapeutics public.

items.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Soufflé cooks up $135M; Matchpoint makes $150M
items.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.

items.title: Roche inks $1.2B deal with China's Rona to enter emerging ALK7 obesity race
items.summary: Roche has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to license Rona Therapeutics’ ALK7 drug candidate, joining Alnylam, Arrowhead, GSK and Novo Nordisk in an emerging obesity niche.

items.title: Pfizer pens $500M Enodia pact to join Lilly in emerging protein degrader field
items.summary: Pfizer has followed Eli Lilly into the Sec61 space, inking a $500 million deal with Enodia Therapeutics days after its Big Pharma peer formed an $870 million pact with Gate Bioscience.

items.title: Nurix drops one BTK degrader as momentum builds behind Roche-partnered option
items.summary: Nurix’s BTK degrader zelebrudomide may have survived a clinical hold in recent years, but that hasn’t stopped the California biotech from dropping the cancer drug.

items.title: Roche sets sights on FDA approval decision of July 2027 with updated eye drug data
items.summary: One year on from a mixed phase 3 readout, Roche has shared updated data from eye disease trials that could support FDA approval by July.

items.title: Tortugas’ schizophrenia drug proves worth in phase 2 Hansoh trial in China
items.summary: Tortugas Neuroscience’s schizophrenia drug from Hansoh Pharma has proven its worth in a phase 2b study, validating the fledgling biotech’s neurology strategy.

items.title: BMS doubles up with pivotal wins in lung disease, solid tumor that offer hope for post-patent cliff growth
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has reported phase 3 wins in a lung disease and a solid tumor, taking two steps on its path toward post-patent cliff growth.

items.title: iRegene Therapeutics’s NouvSight001 Cleared for Clinical Trials in the U.S. and China for Retinitis Pigmentosa
items.summary: Following its Parkinson’s disease program, iRegene advances another off-the-shelf cell therapy into clinical development in the U.S. and China.

items.title: Merck’s deeper dive into efficacy, safety of $1.3B eye disease drug raises fears of ‘limited’ potential
items.summary: Merck & Co. has poured out its Brunello data, revealing a mix of undifferentiated efficacy and concerning safety that led analysts to predict “limited competitive potential” in diabetic macular edema. The company paid $1.3 billion upfront in 2024 to buy the asset and the rest of Eyebiotech.

items.title: Parkinson’s-focused Aspen and bispecific biotech Bambusa plan IPOs
items.summary: Parkinson’s disease cell therapy-focused Aspen Neuroscience and bispecific biotech Bambusa Therapeutics are the latest drug developers to eye up a public listing.

items.title: Ferass Abuzaina named Worldwide President of Surgery at BD
items.summary: Becton, Dickinson and Company has named Ferass Abuzaina as its new Worldwide President of its Surgery business unit.

items.title: FDA clears ImmunityBio’s Anktiva expansion in bladder cancer after regulatory whiplash
items.summary: To expand Anktiva’s label, the FDA adopted a new approach to how it evaluates treatments for BCG-unresponsive NMIBC. The new regulatory path essentially allowed ImmunityBio to bypass an expensive phase 3 trial that competitor Johnson & Johnson is currently forced to grind through.

items.title: Ultragenyx makes swift $413M return on FDA review vouchers after summer of gene therapy nods
items.summary: Hot off a pair of key FDA approvals this summer, rare disease specialist Ultragenyx has wasted little time cashing in on the priority review vouchers it earned from the green lights.

items.title: United lands 'clear-cut win' as Liquidia agrees to $380M settlement in Tyvaso patent infringement saga
items.summary: With a years-long patent dispute between the two drugmakers finally put to bed—complete with a hefty settlement payout—United Therapeutics has clinched what one analyst calls a “clear-cut win” over lung disease rival Liquidia Technologies.

items.title: Galderma bulks up dermatology portfolio with $1.5B acquisition of Zo Skin Health
items.summary: Expanding its presence in dermatology, Cetaphil maker Galderma has agreed to acquire professional skincare shop Zo Skin Health for $1.5 billion.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Pierre Fabre's Ebvallo takes 3rd run at FDA approval
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: FTC seeks sanctions against Martin Shkreli over alleged pharma ban violations
items.summary: The FTC alleges that “Pharma Bro” Martin Shkreli flagrantly traded pharmaceutical stocks on social media for three years, violating his lifetime ban from the industry.

items.title: NantWorks' Soon-Shiong puts chips behind manufacturing disruptors in new rounds for Prolific Machines, Multiply Labs
items.summary: With demand for advanced manufacturing solutions mounting across the industry, the moment is ripe to capitalize on investor interest and build out toward a potential production paradigm shift.

items.title: Sanofi dodges EU fine over alleged disparagement of CSL flu vaccine
items.summary: Sanofi has avoided a European Union fine after antitrust regulators accepted its commitments to address the alleged disparagement of CSL Seqirus’ rival flu vaccine.
